722560101.text: There are two rows of text on this headstone. The first row is in the script of Byakuyakoku and is unintelligible.

722560102.text: The second row is in the common script, and it goes as follows:

722560103.text: "Here lies Risutaiosu no Mikoto, who loved to imitate the craftsmen who molded with clay, creating sculptures of the female officials of the court that were exquisite and lifelike."
